rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an intended goal or purpose.

example.english: My aim in learning Cantonese is to communicate with local neighbors.
example.traditional: 我學廣東話嘅目的係同街坊溝通。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2 ge3 muk6 dik1 hai6 tung4 gaai1 fong1 kau1 tung1

rows.note: Use this for a target to be reached or hit, especially a concrete goal.

example.english: My aim this year is to finish a half-marathon.
example.traditional: 我今年嘅目標係跑完個半馬。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 nin4 ge3 muk6 biu1 hai6 paau2 jyun4 go3 bun3 maa5

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for intending or planning to do something.

example.english: I aim to learn to drive next month.
example.jyutping: ngo5 daa2 syun3 haa6 go3 jyut6 hok6 ce1

rows.note: Use this when aiming a weapon or projectile precisely at a target.

example.english: They aim at the target before firing.
example.jyutping: keoi5 miu4 zeon2 go3 baa2 sin1 hoi1 coeng1

rows.note: Use this for someone’s accuracy or aim when pointing or shooting a weapon.

example.english: They have very good aim when throwing darts.
example.jyutping: keoi5 se6 fei1 biu1 hou2 jau5 zeon2 tau4

rows.note: Use this when directing an action, criticism, or remark against a particular person or group.

example.english: They aim their criticism at us.
example.traditional: 佢哋針對我哋作出批評。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zam1 deoi3 ngo5 dei6 zok3 ceot1 pai1 ping4

rows.note: Use this for physically pointing or directing something toward a target without stressing precise weapon aiming.

example.english: They aim the arrow at the bullseye.
example.jyutping: keoi5 zoeng1 zi1 zin3 zi2 hoeng3 go3 hung4 sam1
